metadata.case_name: WONG YUEN MEI v. YOUNG YAU YAU CECELIA

injuries.description: the extraction of her 4 first molars
source: The Defendant prescribed a course of orthodontic treatment (“the treatment”) which involved the extraction of her 4 first molars with regular check-up sessions about once every 2 weeks after the extraction.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of teeth or supporting structures

injuries.description: tooth decay in 13 of her teeth
source: Due to the extraction of her 4 first molars, there are now huge gaps between her teeth, which cannot close up significantly despite Dr. Leung’s effort. Food would be trapped in those gaps, which resulted in tooth decay in 13 of her teeth.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of hard dental tissues and pulp

injuries.description: the 2nd molars of the Plaintiff were tipped and tilted; the grinding surfaces of the teeth would be adversely affected and the ordinary chewing function would diminish
source: Dr. Ling found that the 2nd molars of the Plaintiff were tipped and tilted, the grinding surfaces of the teeth would be adversely affected and the ordinary chewing function would diminish.

injuries.description: symptoms of mild temporo-mandibular joint dysfunctions, which included the symptoms of pain and of the clicking and crepitus of jaw joints
source: Further, the Plaintiff is found to have symptoms of mild temporo-mandibular joint dysfunctions, which included the symptoms of pain and of the clicking and crepitus of jaw joints.

injuries.description: ulcer of gum, causing serious pain when she ate, drank or spoke
source: she suffered from ulcer of gum, causing serious pain when she ate, drank or spoke;
